newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows fall in 2-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows fall in 2-day period - survey.

text.p: Industrywide cash flows into U.S. stock funds fell to an estimated $1.2 billion for the two days ended April 21 from $1.9 billion for the three days ended April 17, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

Growth and income funds fell sharply to $728 million from $1.2 billion, aggressive growth dropped to $31 million from $355 million, and international funds recorded outflows of $345 million from inflows of $2.1 billion.
Growth funds jumped to $408 million from $337 million.

Bond funds had inflows of $369 million versus $329 million. Muni funds posted inflows of $440 million compared to $251 million, and high yield funds posted inflows of $45 million compared to $24 million.
Government/GMNA had outflows of $30 million versus outflows of $233 million. Corporate/income/global funds suffered outflows of $162 million versus inflows of $154 million.
